description: Migrate the 6 stateful extensions from init(api, agent_pid) to init(api) + mount/0 + 3-arity handle_* callbacks. Each extension migrates independently. Requires Phase 2 macro to be complete. provider_payload.ex does NOT migrate -- it takes a log_fn callback, not state.

comments.text: Audit (2026-04-26): mount/0 callback shape is correct, but the per-extension Agent implementation is unnecessary given dispatch is sequential through the Runner. State threading through the Runner's state map is the simpler model. opi-fin.17 migrates extensions and opi-fin.19 removes agent_supervisor/state_agent.

title: Phase 5: Migrate stateful extensions to mount/0
